entry.title: New: Resolution 27 (2024-2026) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
AUTHORIZES THE MAYOR TO ENTER INTO INTERGOVERNMENTAL AGREEMENTS WITH FEDERAL AND STATE PARTNERS TO SUPPORT THEIR CONTINUED COOPERATION WITH THE HAWAI‘I POLICE DEPARTMENT FOR THE SAFETY OF THE COUNTY OF HAWAI‘I

Allows for the Police Department to officially partner with various and numerous entities listed in an “Index of Agreements” as attached to the resolution and labeled as “Exhibit A”. The Index of Agreements authorizes one intergovernmental agreement with the County’s Office of Housing and Community Development, 13 agreements amongst nine State agencies, 10 agreements amongst eight Federal agencies, and four agreements with the private sector.
